niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean, light, app-like interfaces that feel finished, structured, and easy to scan. They like clear hierarchy, concise copy, balanced spacing, and fully populated screens with visible actions and complete settings. They generally reject sparse, placeholder-like, overly dark, overly promotional, or visually cluttered layouts. They also prefer strong but restrained emphasis: obvious primary actions, clear labels, and polished controls without excessive decoration.

criteria.description: Screens should feel fully populated, with visible settings, entries, and actions rather than empty, sparse, or placeholder-like areas.
The interface should have a strong title-first structure with clearly separated sections and easy-to-follow grouping.
The user prefers balanced padding, even vertical distribution, and enough breathing room to avoid cramped or top-heavy layouts.
Text should be short, clear, and purposeful, avoiding verbose explanations or overly promotional language.
The UI should look finished, contemporary, and intentional rather than generic, outdated, or draft-like.
Primary actions, toggles, and row-level controls should be obvious, legible, and easy to act on immediately.
The user tends to prefer light, airy surfaces and restrained contrast over heavy, dark, or overly harsh visual treatment.
Labels should be concrete and easy to understand, using familiar setting names and explicit descriptions of what each item does.
The user prefers straightforward settings-list or step-based flows with clear progression cues and familiar drill-down behavior.
Accent colors and icon treatments should support the content without becoming overly loud, washed out, or visually distracting.
